title.pinyin: Wǒ dāng māo de yì tiān

summary.english: A small white cat named Snow looks for food and finds a cozy bed.
summary.chinese: 一只叫雪儿的小白猫找食物，找到了舒服的床。
summary.pinyin: Yì zhī jiào Xuě'ér de xiǎo bái māo zhǎo shíwù, zhǎo dàole shūfu de chuáng.

segments.english: I am a cat. I am a small cat.
segments.chinese: 我是猫。我是小猫。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ shì māo. Wǒ shì xiǎo māo.
segments.audioText: 我是猫。我是小猫。

segments.english: I am a white cat. My name is Snow.
segments.chinese: 我是白猫。我名字叫雪儿。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ shì bái māo. Wǒ míngzi jiào Xuě'ér.
segments.audioText: 我是白猫。我名字叫雪儿。

segments.english: I open my eyes. I am in a box.
segments.chinese: 我睁开眼睛。我在盒子里。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ zhēngkāi yǎnjīng. Wǒ zài hézi lǐ.
segments.audioText: 我睁开眼睛。我在盒子里。

segments.english: The box is small. The box is warm. I like this box.
segments.chinese: 盒子很小。盒子很暖和。我喜欢这个盒子。
segments.pinyin: Hézi hěn xiǎo. Hézi hěn nuǎnhuo. Wǒ xǐhuan zhège hézi.
segments.audioText: 盒子很小。盒子很暖和。我喜欢这个盒子。

segments.english: But I am hungry. I go to find food.
segments.chinese: 但是我饿了。我去找食物。
segments.pinyin: Dànshì wǒ è le. Wǒ qù zhǎo shíwù.
segments.audioText: 但是我饿了。我去找食物。

segments.english: I walk and walk. I see a big chair.
segments.chinese: 我走啊走。我看见一把大椅子。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu a zǒu. Wǒ kànjiàn yì bǎ dà yǐzi.
segments.audioText: 我走啊走。我看见一把大椅子。

segments.english: I sit on the chair. The chair is soft. I can sleep here.
segments.chinese: 我坐在椅子上。椅子很软。我可以在这里睡觉。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ zuò zài yǐzi shàng. Yǐzi hěn ruǎn. Wǒ kěyǐ zài zhèlǐ shuìjiào.
segments.audioText: 我坐在椅子上。椅子很软。我可以在这里睡觉。

segments.english: No, I am hungry. I go to find food.
segments.chinese: 不，我饿了。我去找食物。
segments.pinyin: Bù, wǒ è le. Wǒ qù zhǎo shíwù.
segments.audioText: 不，我饿了。我去找食物。

segments.english: I see a table. The table is high.
segments.chinese: 我看见一张桌子。桌子很高。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn yì zhāng zhuōzi. Zhuōzi hěn gāo.
segments.audioText: 我看见一张桌子。桌子很高。

segments.english: I jump on the table. There is no food on the table.
segments.chinese: 我跳上桌子。桌子上没有食物。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ tiào shàng zhuōzi. Zhuōzi shàng méiyǒu shíwù.
segments.audioText: 我跳上桌子。桌子上没有食物。

segments.english: I see a cup. The cup has water.
segments.chinese: 我看见一个杯子。杯子里有水。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn yí gè bēizi. Bēizi lǐ yǒu shuǐ.
segments.audioText: 我看见一个杯子。杯子里有水。

segments.english: I drink the water. The water is cold. I like the water.
segments.chinese: 我喝水。水很凉。我喜欢水。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ hē shuǐ. Shuǐ hěn liáng. Wǒ xǐhuan shuǐ.
segments.audioText: 我喝水。水很凉。我喜欢水。

segments.english: But I am still hungry. I go to find food.
segments.chinese: 但是我还是很饿。我去找食物。
segments.pinyin: Dànshì wǒ háishì hěn è. Wǒ qù zhǎo shíwù.
segments.audioText: 但是我还是很饿。我去找食物。

segments.english: I see a bed. The bed is big.
segments.chinese: 我看见一张床。床很大。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn yì zhāng chuáng. Chuáng hěn dà.
segments.audioText: 我看见一张床。床很大。

segments.english: I jump on the bed. The bed is soft and warm. I can sleep here.
segments.chinese: 我跳上床。床很软很暖和。我可以在这里睡觉。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ tiào shàng chuáng. Chuáng hěn ruǎn hěn nuǎnhuo. Wǒ kěyǐ zài zhèlǐ shuìjiào.
segments.audioText: 我跳上床。床很软很暖和。我可以在这里睡觉。

segments.english: But I am very hungry. I go to find food.
segments.chinese: 但是我非常饿。我去找食物。
segments.pinyin: Dànshì wǒ fēicháng è. Wǒ qù zhǎo shíwù.
segments.audioText: 但是我非常饿。我去找食物。

segments.english: I walk and walk. I see a room. The room has a box.
segments.chinese: 我走啊走。我看见一个房间。房间里有一个盒子。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu a zǒu. Wǒ kànjiàn yí gè fángjiān. Fángjiān lǐ yǒu yí gè hézi.
segments.audioText: 我走啊走。我看见一个房间。房间里有一个盒子。

segments.english: The box is on the floor. I look in the box.
segments.chinese: 盒子在地上。我往盒子里看。
segments.pinyin: Hézi zài dì shàng. Wǒ wǎng hézi lǐ kàn.
segments.audioText: 盒子在地上。我往盒子里看。

segments.english: There is food in the box. The food is for me.
segments.chinese: 盒子里有食物。食物是给我的。
segments.pinyin: Hézi lǐ yǒu shíwù. Shíwù shì gěi wǒ de.
segments.audioText: 盒子里有食物。食物是给我的。

segments.english: I eat the food. The food is good. I am happy.
segments.chinese: 我吃食物。食物很好吃。我高兴。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ chī shíwù. Shíwù hěn hǎochī. Wǒ gāoxìng.
segments.audioText: 我吃食物。食物很好吃。我高兴。

segments.english: Now I am not hungry. I am full. I am sleepy.
segments.chinese: 现在我不饿了。我饱了。我困了。
segments.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ bú è le. Wǒ bǎo le. Wǒ kùn le.
segments.audioText: 现在我不饿了。我饱了。我困了。

segments.english: I go back to the chair. No, the bed is better.
segments.chinese: 我回到椅子那儿。不，床更好。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ huí dào yǐzi nàr. Bù, chuáng gèng hǎo.
segments.audioText: 我回到椅子那儿。不，床更好。

segments.english: I go to the bed. I jump on the bed.
segments.chinese: 我去床边。我跳上床。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ qù chuáng biān. Wǒ tiào shàng chuáng.
segments.audioText: 我去床边。我跳上床。

segments.english: The bed is soft. The bed is warm. I close my eyes.
segments.chinese: 床很软。床很暖和。我闭上眼睛。
segments.pinyin: Chuáng hěn ruǎn. Chuáng hěn nuǎnhuo. Wǒ bì shàng yǎnjīng.
segments.audioText: 床很软。床很暖和。我闭上眼睛。

segments.english: I sleep. I am a happy cat.
segments.chinese: 我睡觉。我是一只高兴的猫。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ shuìjiào. Wǒ shì yì zhī gāoxìng de māo.
segments.audioText: 我睡觉。我是一只高兴的猫。

source.approvedEnglish:
My Day as a Cat

I am a cat. I am a small cat. I am a white cat. My name is Snow.

I open my eyes. I am in a box. The box is small. The box is warm. I like this box. But I am hungry. I go to find food.

I walk and walk. I see a big chair. I sit on the chair. The chair is soft. I can sleep here. No, I am hungry. I go to find food.

I see a table. The table is high. I jump on the table. There is no food on the table. I see a cup. The cup has water. I drink the water. The water is cold. I like the water. But I am still hungry. I go to find food.

I see a bed. The bed is big. I jump on the bed. The bed is soft and warm. I can sleep here. But I am very hungry. I go to find food.

I walk and walk. I see a room. The room has a box. The box is on the floor. I look in the box. There is food in the box. The food is for me. I eat the food. The food is good. I am happy.

Now I am not hungry. I am full. I am sleepy. I go back to the chair. No, the bed is better. I go to the bed. I jump on the bed. The bed is soft. The bed is warm. I close my eyes. I sleep. I am a happy cat.
